lines.text: The remnant of Jacob among many peoples will be like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass.
The remnant of Jacob among the nations will be like a lion among the beasts of the forest.
All the enemies will be cut off, and the LORD will remove the horses and wreck the ships.
The LORD will tear down the strongholds, cut the sorceries, and cut off the carved images so people stop bowing to their own handiwork.
The LORD will root out the Asherah poles and take vengeance on the nations that have never been warned.
